To: support@clockpoint.example
Replying to: m01
Cc: kevin.mutua@tausifreight.example
Subject: Re: [CP-48213] Overtime coding issue on night shifts

Dear Faith,

Thank you for picking this up. Here are the details you asked for.

1. Terminal model and firmware: BX-300. The four terminals at our Embakasi depot auto-updated from 4.1.8 to 4.2.1 on the night of 27 October. Our two Mombasa Road terminals are still on 4.1.8.
2. Shift template: NIGHT-8, 22:00 to 06:00.
3. Example staff ID T-0417. Clocked in 21:54 on 30 October and out at 06:07 on 31 October. The Payroll CSV v2 export shows 2.1 hrs REG on 30 October and 6.1 hrs OT15 on 31 October. We expected 8.0 hrs REG and 0.2 hrs OT15, since the 13 minutes outside the scheduled shift are the only overtime. The export is splitting any shift that crosses midnight into two lines, and the after-midnight part is coded as OT15.
4. Export profile: Payroll CSV v2.
5. We first noticed it on 5 November, while reviewing the October overtime draft. It appears to have started around 28 October.

This affects 38 night-shift staff. The 4.2.1 release notes promised better handling of shifts that span two calendar days, but for us it has done the opposite. Our October overtime came out about KES 212,000 too high, and we have been correcting it by hand from the raw punches. November payroll inputs close on Friday 20 November, so we need either a fix or a clear workaround before then.

I have two specific questions:

- Can you confirm a fix or workaround for the midnight split?
- Can our IT team safely roll the four Embakasi terminals back to 4.1.8? We need to know whether a rollback risks losing any offline punch data stored on the devices.

Kevin Mutua, our payroll officer, will test whatever you suggest, so I have copied him. Please send the fix or workaround to both of us.

Kind regards,

Njeri Mwangi
HR Manager, Tausi Freight
